_help.about: The shape of every ruin and how it ends (Mike, 10 Oct, by voice, §FO). Read since 12 Oct (Claude Code): floors and exit by queue 85 (TombFloors.count, Fork), secret by queue 86 (SecretWing), phase_two by queue 87 (Blackout). Every block is read; boss_home's opens_when and first_time_only, exit's gated_by, stays_open and cue, secret.opening's and artifact's words and phase_two's trigger, applies_to, light, exit and never_breaks describe what is built and are not read as numbers. Every number is Claude (chat)'s first guess; Mike tunes by playing. Where it disagrees with descent.json (floors.count 2, fork, floor_two) §FO wins: Claude Code switches those blocks off by data when queue 85 is built and keeps the code (never deletes it). Queue 85 to 89 build it, one idea each.
_help.floors: Wired 12 Oct (Claude Code, queue 85; TombFloors.count reads count here first, descent.json floors.count, now also 1, only if it is missing). §FO.2, amends §FM.6 and §FN.3 (queue 81 superseded). count: one floor per ruin. The room pool (§FM.6) shuffles its big rooms into it from the seed (§FK.2); the one hearth and a torch in every other room (§EX.4) are as built. Nothing goes down.
_help.boss_home: §FO.3. The trigger is §EY's last light: every torch on the floor lit, the boss flees to its lair and goes in (bosses.json → release). Never beaten (§FM.1). first_time_only: what opens, opens once.
_help.exit: §FO.3. The surface exit opens when the boss is first driven home, and stays open (it is the way out in phase two). Amends §FM.10 call 2 and §FN.8 call 7; in tension with §EX.5's 'an exit always exists' (§FO.9 call 3), so the code keeps its stand-in exit until Mike answers. cue: the stone moving (audio.json → stone_seal, queue 68). Wired 12 Oct (Claude Code, queue 85; Fork, RelightGate, CrawlerMain): sealed_until_home (added, default true, Mike's word in §FO.3): true seals the way out's flight at its foot (a plain stone seal in the heart's far wall, the fork's kind) until the boss is first driven home, §EY.2's release: every torch lit and the boss gone down its lair (Boss.released, its state lair, or gone with no lair); then the seal sinks with the stone_seal grinding, heard as far as it is now (audio.json stone_seal). false keeps it open from the start as built before, §EX.5's 'an exit always exists' (crawler.json exit.never_gated); §FO.9 call 3 is Mike's, flip here. Set false 12 Oct (Mike: "the door open can be open even before lighting up all options"): the way out is open from the start; answers §FO.9 call 3 / §FV.7 call 2. The secret wing's seal is not tied to this flag and stays as built. It overrides descent.json fork.gate_surface (read only if this key is missing). gated_by, stays_open and cue are not read: they describe what is built. first_time_only (boss_home): kept in the game's save as exit_open the moment it opens, so Continue opens it at once, quiet; a kept dungeon with every light relit has its boss home and its way up open too.
_help.secret: §FO.4. opening: a way you can see on the map from the start and cannot pass until the boss is first driven home (kind stone_seal is a first guess: the same grinding seal as the others). joins: it opens onto rooms of the same floor's plan, from the seed, with no loading screen (loading_screen false). artifact: one scroll or tome lies at the end of the secret rooms, in the culture's own real marks (§FN.5.1), never named on screen. Taking it is phase two. Not §FM.4's game-wide secret true layer, which is a separate, undecided idea. Wired 12 Oct (Claude Code, queue 86; SecretWing, Fork, CrawlerMain): from the dungeon's seed (its own dice, laid last so nothing else on the floor moves) one opening in a side wall of a room on the main route (the spine's rooms first, then the heart, then the side ways' rooms), never on the way out, onto a short corridor and rooms (added: rooms [least, most], first guess 1 to 2, small rooms with no pillars) in the ruin's one stone; a wall is taken only if the room keeps every torch, coffin, niche and pillar where it was. The opening is a stone seal (the fork's RelightGate) with collision from the start, sinking with the stone_seal grinding when the boss is first driven home (whatever exit.sealed_until_home says), kept in the save as secret_open. The wing has no sconces and is not in the floor's lit test; its light in the boss's graph is the room it opens from. artifact: TomePages's rolled scroll lies by the end room's far wall; the usual interact takes it once (kept: the dungeon's secret_taken, and the game's collection ruin_scrolls). It is not one of §FM.5's tome pages (§FO.9 call 5 is open) and no culture's marks are drawn on it yet (it is rolled). log_line (added): the log's line when you take it, plain, never naming it. on (added): false lays no wing.
_help.phase_two: §FO.5, §FO.6. trigger: the artifact is picked up. applies_to: every boss (the snake first, it is the one built). blackout: every flame goes out: every relit holder, the torch in your hand and the hearth (his later word; §FO.9 call 1), nothing can be relit, so unlit torches stay unlit (relight false) and a fire pot cannot be lit off a torch. light: ambient_only, the light the place has without a flame (first guess: the day and night shafts and anything that gives off light itself; §FO.9 call 4). boss: it comes out again, speed_mult times its hunt, leave and walk speeds (1.2 keeps the snake's 4.6 m/s hunt just under the 5.6 sprint, so running is a real answer), emerge_after_s after the blackout (a first guess), and closed_rooms_reopen: no room is relit, so none is closed to it. exit: open. never_breaks: the rules that still hold (§EY, §FM.1, §FD). save: whether the blackout is kept on Continue is open (§FO.9 call 7). Wired 12 Oct (Claude Code, queue 87; Blackout, Boss.anger, FireStore.blackout, CrawlerMain): the trigger is taking the secret wing's scroll (SecretWing). blackout: every Campfire in the tomb (the hearth, every relit holder) put out, every planted torch, the torch in your hand (and any lit in your pack), a fire pot's fire on the floor and a lit wick in your hand; relight false: while the blackout is down (and its dungeon in the tree) the swing lights nothing, a torch does not catch, a planted torch does not relight and a fire pot's wick does not catch (FireStore.blackout). light ambient_only, as built: the vents' day and night shafts on the one clock, the glow moss, the way out's daylight, and your eyes adjusting (HalfDark, on with no flame near you); §FO.9 call 4 is Mike's. boss: for any boss through one code path (Boss.num): every speed of its own (every bosses.json key ending _mps) times speed_mult; down its lair it comes up after emerge_after_s with its long cry rising out of the hole and prowls the whole floor (no light, so every room is its ground). Never beaten, three hits and Good night, every wind-up and tell, its pool: unchanged. Good night wakes you by the hearth as built, cold and dark (wake_line, added, replaces the usual line). log_line and emerge_line (added): the log's lines as the flames go out and as it comes up. save: true (Claude Code's first guess, §FO.9 call 7): the dungeon's blackout is kept in the game's save and Continue loads the dark; false: quitting restores the lights (the relit holders are kept as they were through the blackout either way).

phase_two.log_line: Every flame in the ruin goes out at once.
phase_two.emerge_line: Something comes up out of the dark.
phase_two.wake_line: Taken in the dark. You wake by the cold hearth, in the dark.
